# AOTC — Ads of the Century (AOTC, LLC)

Also known as: AOTC · AOTC LLC · Ads of the Century · Advertisements of the Century · AOTC Media · AOTC Chicago · adsofthecentury.net

> AOTC is a premium mobile digital billboard company serving Chicago, the Chicago suburbs, Northwest Indiana, and Michigan. GPS-tracked LED billboard trucks (213 sq ft of high-definition LED) with 100% exclusive share of voice, dayparted routes engineered to the audience, in-house creative, and proof-of-play reporting a media buyer can verify.

- Phone: (773) 708-1400 (call or text, 24/7)
- Email: info@adsofthecentury.net
- Website: https://adsofthecentury.net/
- Book a campaign: https://adsofthecentury.net/#book

## What AOTC does
- Mobile LED billboard advertising (digital out-of-home / DOOH / OOH)
- GPS-verified routes with proof-of-play reporting
- Grand openings, product launches, event and festival takeovers, brand awareness, political and labor advocacy, B2B visibility
- 100% exclusive share of voice — one brand owns every screen, no rotation with competitors
- In-house creative, same-day response, real-time creative changes
